proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
  classical
  intro N inst i m n
  have hm : ∀ a b : M6.Transfer.Memory 0, a = b := fun a b => Subsingleton.elim a b
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 2)) = {0, 1} := by decide
  have hout : ∀ t : ZMod 2,
      M6.Transfer.localOutput (M6.ActualTransfer.window 0 1) m t = t := by
    intro t
    simp [M6.Transfer.localOutput, M6.ActualTransfer.window]
  simp only [M6.Transfer.edgeMatrix, hm, ite_true]
  simp only [M6.ActualTransfer.characterWeight, hout,
    M6.Character.free_character_factor]
  rw [hu]
  norm_num [Finset.sum_insert, Finset.sum_singleton, M6.Character.sign]
  <;> ring
